blocks.text: Find out the molarity of NaOH solution by using the following molarity equation:
V₁ = Volume of the acid used
n₁ = No. of moles of the acid in the balanced chemical equation
V₂ = Volume of base solution used
n₂ = No. of moles of the base in the balanced chemical equation
Molarity of the given base solution is ____ M.

blocks.prompt: a) Define indicator and endpoint in a titration.
blocks.explanation: An indicator is a substance that shows by a change of colour that the reaction is complete (for example phenolphthalein). The end point is the moment the indicator changes colour; in this titration it is when the pink colour disappears.

blocks.prompt: b) What is meant by concordant reading?
blocks.explanation: Readings of repeated titrations that agree with one another within 0.1 cm³. At least three concordant readings are taken so that the result is reliable.
